item.title: Green Day’s Billie Joe Armstrong Crashes San Diego Comic-Con For Pop-Up Ice Cream Truck Performance of ‘Basket Case’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our show! Today, we're talking about a exciting new project from a talented singer. Let's dive right in."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The singer recently made an appearance at Gallagher Square, just outside Petco Park. But why were they there? The answer is to promote their group's upcoming film, Nimrods."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Nimrods is being billed as a coming-of-age rock comedy, and we can't wait to learn more about it. We'll be keeping an eye out for more updates on this project, and we'll be sure to share them with you as soon as we get them."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
